improvements: The bot no longer treats nearby treasure across an observed wall as a reason to save levitation for that room. It still keeps the potion reserved when the connecting terrain is uncertain.
incoming_learnings: Nearby loot across a positively observed wall is not evidence that levitation retrieves it. Keep uncertain geometry conservative, preserve real uncollected rewards, and require fresh protection and pickup receipts. Selecting crystal-key preparation does not establish successful retrieval or eventual descent.

recommendations.summary: Allow verified safe armor preparation when uncertain equipped armor blocks a required levitation trip.
evidence: Decision 1533, log line 4555: unidentified leather armor equipped.
Decision 1691, log line 4976: mandatory golden keys lack an ordinary route.
Decision 1692, log line 4980: full-health living hero retains known levitation and identified safe cloth armor.
tools/room_tactics.py:198-206 and tools/combat_items.py:39-45 reject timed trips with unidentified armor.
recommendations.reason: Patch passed isolated validation and was accepted.

review.review: The run ended in planner exhaustion with the hero alive at full health, not an observed death. Decision 1691's resource diagnostic identifies three inaccessible golden keys; the generic upgrade/strength message is misleading. The strength potion and upgrade scroll had inventory-backed pickups at decisions 1386 and 1529. Decision 1533 equipped unidentified leather armor. The protected-trip planner correctly rejects uncertain movement equipment, but lacked preparation to equip the carried, identified, curse-known safe cloth armor. Known levitation remained available. A reduced public-observation fixture reproduces the missing preparation, and an isolated terminal-observation probe selects cloth armor with the correction. No original runtime-memory reconstruction or future gameplay success is claimed. The proposed correction only admits a quiet, near-full-health equipment change after unchanged route and timing checks succeed on an isolated inventory alternative; mandatory pickups, actual protection checks and planner-exhaustion reporting remain enforced.
review.learnings: When a mandatory protected pickup is blocked by uncertain movement equipment, consider carried, identified, curse-known safe armor as preparation only after verifying the full trip under that alternative. Reobserve equipment and protection before entering danger. Choosing preparation does not establish collection or puzzle success.
